characters.prompt: [CAMERA] Close-up portrait, 85mm, f/1.8, eye level, subject on the right third, the LEFT HALF of the frame kept dark and empty for text. 16:9 widescreen, one single photorealistic film still, NOT a grid. [CHARACTER] The Japanese man from reference image 1 — Takamiya Genzo, aged 78, lean angular weathered face with deep wrinkles, close-cropped white hair, a short neat white beard, one small dark mole above his LEFT eyebrow, NO glasses, NO earrings, wearing a plain faded grey zip-up jacket. Reproduce exactly this face. No name tag, no text. [ACTION] Looking straight into the lens, eyebrows drawn together, lips parted and trembling, eyes red-rimmed and wet, one thin clear tear track down each cheek, matte natural skin (no glossy gel tears). [SETTING] The dim corner seat of an upscale Japanese restaurant at night: dark wood wall panels and a white tablecloth blurred in the background, a single pendant lamp overhead casting a cold cone of light, dust motes in the air, teal-grey color grade, low key, cinematic film grain. Reference image 2 is only for the restaurant look. [NEGATIVE] text, letters, logo, watermark, extra fingers, anime, smile, bright lighting, glasses, earrings, grid, split panels.

[CAMERA] Wide shot, slight high angle, 24mm, deep focus, 16:9, one single illustration, NOT a grid. Heroine large in the left foreground, antagonist kneeling center-right, the old man standing far right; the upper-left quarter left open for text. [CHARACTER] Japanese manga-style digital illustration, clean bold linework, cel shading with soft gradients (NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D). Heroine = Chihiro from reference image 1: Japanese woman aged 20, black hair with straight bangs tied in a low ponytail, NO glasses, white blouse and navy apron, hugging a tray with a steaming bowl of plain udon to her chest. Antagonist = Iwaki from reference image 2: restaurant manager aged 45, black hair slicked back, thin black moustache, small black stud earrings, black three-piece suit, silver tie, a small blank metal name plate, sweating, on his knees, mouth open in panic, holding an empty silver bill tray. The old man = Takamiya Genzo from reference image 3: aged 78, lean, close-cropped white hair, short white beard, small mole above his LEFT eyebrow, NO glasses, NO earrings, plain grey zip-up jacket, standing tall over him with arms at his sides. Blurred crowd of diners and staff in dark clothes behind. [ACTION] The heroine glances sideways at the kneeling man with a calm, steady expression; the kneeling man trembles; the old man looks down in stern silence. [SETTING] Luxury restaurant banquet hall at night, crystal chandeliers, warm red and gold lighting, red carpet, white tablecloths, spotlight beams from above, dramatic warm-cool contrast. [NEGATIVE] text, letters, logo, watermark, photorealistic, extra limbs, blurry faces on main characters, glasses on the heroine, grid, split panels.
